answer: Under escalating attempt-toll admission, every registration epoch on the nebula network sets its VDF difficulty equal to the square of all attempts already submitted that epoch, counting failures and abandoned dune files. One honest agent arriving first pays one delta unit of sequential work, while a botnet batching m=100 fake identities raises the toll to 10,000 units per attempt, so total batch cost grows as m-cubed, roughly a million units versus one. Honest solo joiners face only the attempts made before them, typically single digits, keeping their cost under ten units.
